note: The SunnyBay Daily (Social B, owner 11 Nov): one card on the first open of each day. Everything on it that is words lives here, so it can be changed without code. topics: 14 days from social.md (the day is counted from startDate in SAST and goes round); the topic is matched to the player's interests where it can be, and "Join the conversation" opens that interest's group. posts: the Post of the day, one a day, going round. The Caf special comes from specials.json (by game day), the top 3 of each board and who joined today from the server.
title: The SunnyBay Daily

topics.question: R15 for a taxi to town: fair or robbery?
topics.opener: A marshal called R15 a gift. A first-year called it a joke. The rank is listening. Talk.

topics.question: Kota or bunny: which Caf tray wins lunch?
topics.opener: Mama Liz will not pick a side. Uncle Jaco already has. Your tray is the vote.

topics.question: Gym at dawn, or never again this week?
topics.opener: Luke says the 5am crew owns the campus. The rest of us own the snooze.

topics.question: Library silence, or a table that actually talks?
topics.opener: Grace booked the quiet room. Naledi booked the loud one. Both think they are right.

topics.question: Who has the best house playlist right now?
topics.opener: Tendai says he has heard every corridor. He has not. Prove him wrong tonight.

topics.question: Pier race: legs, or just a lucky taxi?
topics.opener: Winners thank the wind. Losers thank the marshal. The gulls are not taking sides.

topics.question: Friday special: is the queue actually worth it?
topics.opener: The board says Friday. The line says otherwise. Report back with gravy on a sleeve.

topics.question: Notes on paper, or a phone you will drop?
topics.opener: Noah swears three working keys beat a new notebook. Priya would like a word.

topics.question: First car at R4,500: dent included, still yours?
topics.opener: The lot has an honest little one. The dent stays. Would you take the key?

topics.question: Mall cinema tonight, or the same lecture slides?
topics.opener: Screen six is cheap. Chapter four is not. Pick a dark room and own it.

topics.question: Quiet pew, or choir until the lights click?
topics.opener: The brick church does not ask your surname. It does ask if you can hum.

topics.question: Res laundry hero, or one mall-window outfit?
topics.opener: Aya says a seven is fixable. The washing machine says it is a lifestyle.

topics.question: Woza split, or still collecting coins in a cup?
topics.opener: The till takes Woza. Someone still owes three rand from last week's kota.

topics.question: Quad football: boots, or the takkies you slept in?
topics.opener: Jackets for goalposts. No referee. If you show up in slides, the group will notice.

posts.post: If you skipped breakfast I know. Come. The gravy is still here and so am I.
posts.why: Day one. People are hungry and pretending not to be. She said the quiet part.

posts.post: Jollof at Mzansi House. I will be kind about the rice. For ten minutes. Then we talk.
posts.why: The house kitchen just became a diplomatic incident. We are here for it.

posts.post: Study group, campus library, six. Late and I start. Bring a charger, not a speech.
posts.why: Someone has to run the week. Grace volunteered and did not wait for applause.

posts.post: Outfit today is a seven. Fixable. Fitting Thursday if you want an eight.
posts.why: Kind, honest, and now half the Quad is looking down at their shoes.

posts.post: Open mic list is full. I wrote your name anyway. Do not make me look foolish.
posts.why: Friday needs a stage. He already put you on it. That is friendship, and a threat.

posts.post: Pap and a gym. That is the whole personality. Third plate is a love language.
posts.why: Saturday energy. We did not ask for a thesis. We got one anyway.

posts.post: The terrace seat is still mine. Bring an argument or bring rooibos. Both preferred.
posts.why: Sunday. Campus is quiet. The law student is not. Sit if you dare.
